name: reftable-commit-branch-tag
setup:
git init -q --ref-format=reftable . &&
printf 'a\n' > a && git add a && git commit -q -m one &&
printf 'b\n' > b && git add b && git commit -q -m two &&
git branch dev &&
git tag light &&
git tag -a annot -m 'annotated tag'

name: reftable-update-ref-stdin
setup:
git init -q --ref-format=reftable . &&
printf 'x\n' > x && git add x && git commit -q -m c1 &&
C=$(git rev-parse HEAD) &&
printf 'create refs/heads/a %s\ncreate refs/heads/b %s\n' "$C" "$C" | git update-ref --stdin
probes: git update-ref refs/heads/c $(git rev-parse HEAD) && git rev-parse refs/heads/c
printf 'delete refs/heads/a\n' | git update-ref --stdin && git show-ref refs/heads/a; echo exit=$?

name: reftable-symbolic-and-delete
setup:
git init -q --ref-format=reftable . &&
printf 'x\n' > x && git add x && git commit -q -m c1 &&
git branch topic && git tag t1
probes: git symbolic-ref refs/heads/link refs/heads/topic && git symbolic-ref refs/heads/link
git update-ref -d refs/heads/link && git show-ref refs/heads/link; echo exit=$?

name: reftable-reflog
setup:
git init -q --ref-format=reftable . &&
printf '1\n' > f && git add f && git commit -q -m c1 &&
printf '2\n' > f && git add f && git commit -q -m c2 &&
printf '3\n' > f && git add f && git commit -q -m c3

name: reftable-pack-refs-compact
setup:
git init -q --ref-format=reftable . &&
printf 'x\n' > x && git add x && git commit -q -m c1 &&
for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8; do git branch b$i; done

name: reftable-for-each-ref-formats
setup:
git init -q --ref-format=reftable . &&
printf 'x\n' > x && git add x && git commit -q -m c1 &&
git branch feature && git tag -a v1 -m v1

name: migrate-files-to-reftable
setup:
git init -q . &&
printf '1\n' > f && git add f && git commit -q -m c1 &&
git branch dev && git tag -a rel -m rel &&
printf '2\n' > f && git add f && git commit -q -m c2 &&
git for-each-ref > /tmp/before-fer && git show-ref > /tmp/before-sr &&
git reflog show refs/heads/master > /tmp/before-rl &&
git refs migrate --ref-format=reftable
probes: git reflog show refs/heads/master > /tmp/after-rl && diff /tmp/before-rl /tmp/after-rl && echo RL-MATCH

name: migrate-reftable-to-files
setup:
git init -q --ref-format=reftable . &&
printf '1\n' > f && git add f && git commit -q -m c1 &&
git branch dev && git tag -a rel -m rel &&
git for-each-ref > /tmp/before-fer &&
git refs migrate --ref-format=files

name: reftable-branch-rename
setup:
git init -q --ref-format=reftable . &&
printf 'x\n' > x && git add x && git commit -q -m c1 &&
git branch old
probes: git branch -m old new && git show-ref
git branch -m master main && git symbolic-ref HEAD
